title: Expectation as an integral
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite measurable space in which every singleton is measurable, let $p$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $f:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$. The expectation of $f$ under $p$ equals its integral with respect to the measure induced by $p$.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
